name: bada enigma
description: bada enigma: henkan mode types through an Enigma machine; every henkan session starts from the starting state, Backspace turns the rotors back. Settings: {"rotors": ["I", "II", "III"], "reflector": "B", "rings": "AAA", "start": "AAA", "plugboard": "AV BS", "forms": ["upper", "lower", "groups", "plain"], "space": "commit" | "x"}. 半角/全角 in muhenkan enciphers the selection.
